notes: Verified timecoded observations from NASA’s official 151.57-second Artemis I recap.

detections.name: NASA insignia
detections.description: NASA identifiers appear on hardware, apparel, presentation graphics, control-room displays, and the final card.
detections.observation: The closing NASA insignia is full-frame; additional smaller marks recur throughout.

detections.name: Artemis mission identity
detections.description: The Artemis identity appears over the Moon at the opening and as a featured end card.
detections.observation: A designed Artemis wordmark and trajectory symbol fill the frame.

detections.name: Launch Pad 39B
detections.description: The launch complex, visitor viewing area, and control facilities at Kennedy Space Center are shown and named.
detections.observation: The narration names Launch Pad 39B while the SLS stack and launch infrastructure are featured.

detections.name: NASA Artemis I launch footage
detections.description: The complete cut is a NASA-produced recap combining launch, crowd, control-room, spacecraft, and animation material.
detections.observation: The source is the named NASA Image and Video Library recap rather than production-originated footage.

detections.name: Bill Nelson
detections.description: Bill Nelson appears in a sustained podium shot and is identified by a lower-third title.
detections.observation: Nelson’s face, voice, name, and NASA title are clear and central.

detections.name: European Space Agency
detections.description: The narration names the European Service Module while Orion is shown in flight.
detections.observation: The ESA-provided service module is an explicit subject of the narration and spacecraft imagery.

detections.name: Unidentified musical score
detections.description: A cinematic score plays continuously under narration, mission audio, and launch footage.
detections.observation: The recording is prominent but the official captions and public catalog metadata do not identify a title, composer, or label.

detections.name: Kennedy Space Center visitor signage
detections.description: Space Center visitor-area signage and branded apparel are visible among the launch crowd.
detections.observation: A large Space Center sign and NASA-branded clothing are readable in a crowd shot.
